about_the_game:
What Happened to the Miller Family?

Just outside the quiet town of Coffeyville, Kansas, the Miller family—mother Margaret, father Edward, and their 11-year-old daughter Lily—suddenly vanished one night from their old farmhouse.

Authorities found no trace, signs, or evidence of forced entry during their investigation of the area. Shortly after the incident, strange rumors began to spread. Reports emerged of a girl resembling Lily being seen near the farmhouse at night, along with unsettling noises coming from the house.

Michael Wolf, a young journalist working for the town’s local newspaper, decided to investigate the case after hearing these rumors. The claims of a girl resembling Lily appearing around the farmhouse at night compelled him to uncover the truth behind the family's mysterious disappearance.
And so, Michael set off toward the abandoned farmhouse.

Is Lily Dead or Alive?

What happened to Lily? Was she dead, murdered or kidnapped?

Traces of The Past!

The diary entries Lily left behind are eerie and deeply disturbing! Are they a cry for help or demonic vengeance?

Strange Sounds!

Whispers, screams and spooky strange sounds. I wonder what they mean.

Unexpected Truth?

Could what's happening on this farm be real? Or is everything an illusion?

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 12
